disposition.reason: Foundation of Prayer & Word: its scripture/ and concordance/ packages become the canonical reference grammar with the spoken-reference fixes; salvage the child schemas, span locator, revision-keyed ledger tables and understand cases; drop the context builder and trial repair code.

evidence_basis: 187 offline tests and bounded real-data runs; no published output and no reader.

need_source.statement: Link verses to prayer and teaching (the bronze-readiness commission).
After hearing H7 v2: 'much more powerful if every single prayer also had a scripture verse'; the mechanical text-to-speech was the biggest issue.

summary: Cycle 15 foundation (GitHub main 29a6053): reference grammar, six-edition resolver, passage dossiers, reference extraction with positions, quotation detection and FTS5 with 187 offline tests, plus a task ledger and a context builder whose only live run failed with no accepted output. Nothing is published.
